steps.subject: sky
steps.action: bounce white into the colors to start cloud shapes
steps.load: a little white on the round brush
steps.new: white picks up the colors already on the canvas

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: make little circles to mix shapes into the sky

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: add a touch of cad yellow and yellow ochre to white and work out the brightest area
steps.load: little yellow mixed into the white
steps.new: color shows up much stronger on black canvas

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: blend the sky with the corner of a dry 2in brush in tiny circles
steps.rule: keeping some rough edges makes floating clouds

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: add small individual cloud shapes

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: blend the entire sky to soften the brush strokes

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: add sparkles with tight circles on the brush corner
steps.load: a little paint on the brush corner
steps.new: a sparkle adds a bit of life

steps.subject: water line
steps.action: fill the horizon gap with crimson mixed with liquid clear
steps.load: crimson with a little liquid clear
steps.rule: there was no clear or color under the gap

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: load fan brush with white and plan where the major wave lives
steps.load: little white on the fan brush
steps.rule: the major wave is the main element others follow

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: make little wave shapes far back with a wiggly stroke
steps.load: fresh white on the brush, exaggerated wiggles
steps.rule: exaggerating makes small waves read far back

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: wipe the brush and blend the light area back with an angled stroke
steps.rule: keep a dark area along the line

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: load filbert with white and a little cad yellow for the eye
steps.load: loaded with a little cad yellow

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: scrub white and yellow hard into the eye of the wave
steps.rule: light plays along the wave so work outward from the eye

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: wash the brush then make the top of the wave crash over
steps.load: fresh white after washing the brush

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: add a touch of cad yellow to the top of the wave
steps.load: a little cad yellow on the brush
steps.rule: separates the wave from the background

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: mix a lavender shadow color for the foam
steps.rule: a shadow color suits the foam

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: scrub the shadow color into the foam area

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: foam splash: white tinged with cad yellow pushed upward

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: blend the foam very gently with a 1in brush corner

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: blend white with a little cad yellow in the transparency with tiny circles
steps.load: clean dry brush with white and yellow

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: thin the white with yellow and flick a highlight on top of the wave

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: add a line of dark color under the wave
steps.load: dark mix carried on the liner
steps.rule: the line separates the wave from the eye

steps.subject: rock
steps.action: mix van dyke brown, black and dark sienna for a big stone

steps.subject: rock
steps.action: form a basic big stone shape in the water with the fan brush
steps.new: fan brush works well for shaping rocks of this kind

steps.subject: rock
steps.action: add a small point on top of the stone
steps.rule: a place for a seagull to sit

steps.subject: beach
steps.action: add a brown beach at the bottom and light sand
steps.load: brown, then white on the brush

steps.subject: rock
steps.action: add a small highlight on top of the stone
steps.load: a little white with dark sienna
steps.rule: almost a silhouette so the highlight stays small

steps.subject: rock
steps.action: form a big rock in the front with a basic shape
steps.rule: it is so dark it reads as a silhouette

steps.subject: evergreen
steps.action: load phthalo blue, brown and crimson for a scraggly tree

steps.subject: evergreen
steps.action: paint limbs on one side of the scraggly tree
steps.rule: strong wind lets limbs grow only on one side

steps.subject: water
steps.action: load white with a little phthalo blue on the knife
steps.load: small roll cut on the knife edge

steps.subject: water
steps.action: push the knife hard to make ripples

steps.subject: water
steps.action: pull the fan brush across to shape the waves
steps.new: a nice easy way to make a little wave

steps.subject: water
steps.action: pull down and across for reflections
steps.rule: it creates the shine that reflecting water has

steps.subject: water
steps.action: push a small knife ripple under the rock
steps.load: blue and white on the small knife
steps.new: the flat water needs a straight pull next

steps.subject: water
steps.action: pull the fan brush straight back to form a ridge
steps.rule: flat water needs a straight pull

steps.subject: other: small details
steps.action: add thin blue and white details around the rocks
steps.rule: more small details improve the painting

steps.subject: rock
steps.action: pop in small rocks with a filbert, dark on one side and light on the other
steps.load: dark on one side, light on the other
steps.new: one stroke puts the top and bottom of a rock in

steps.subject: rock
steps.action: clean up the rock edges with thin blue
